scope: Development pilot of the QA harness; original attempts remain unchanged in ignored local evidence.

attempts.label: after-pilot-01-carbon
attempts.finding: Large PNG byte arrays were expanded into JSON numbers by the QA helper. The test process was stopped after resource growth; no completed video or product pass is claimed.
attempts.resolution: Lossless base64 transport to the browser replaces numeric-array transport. The original helper and attempt remain retained.

attempts.label: after-pilot-02-border
attempts.finding: The QA helper attempted to fetch a data URL, which the actual application Content Security Policy blocked.
attempts.resolution: The helper now uses atob, Uint8Array and Blob without network fetch or application policy changes. The actual screenshot, failure and raw video are retained.

attempts.label: after-pilot-05-extended-carbon
attempts.finding: Nonrectangular geometry/delete and real delayed-axis response cases passed. The TIFF case stopped at an overbroad QA focus assertion before establishing TIFF isolation.
attempts.resolution: The assertion treated Save-button focus loss during export as a draft input failure. The attempt and raw video remain retained.

attempts.label: after-pilot-06-tiff-carbon
attempts.finding: Baseline PNG and TIFF export completed, but a later real download changed focus from a border select control. The QA helper rejected focus movement before checking final committed state and export pixels.
attempts.resolution: DOM activation still synthesizes no pointer, Tab, blur or focus event. Actual application/download focus effects are now observed separately; exact committed state/history/project, source bytes, decoded export pixels and Undo assertions remain mandatory. Attempt 07 passed those checks.

interpretation: Later scoped passes do not replace either earlier attempt. Both failures concern identified test-helper behavior; they are not evidence of a passed product case.
